options: By grabbing the delicate metal pins
With wet hands right out of the sink
quickCheck.explanation: Holding circuit boards gently by their outer edges keeps all the delicate electronic parts safe and clean!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Electronics are friendly but delicate! Hold circuit boards by their plastic edges, just like a favorite trading card.

quickCheck.question: What cable connects your Arduino to your computer to share power and code?
quickCheck.explanation: A USB cable delivers electrical power and transfers your code from the computer into the Arduino!
quickCheck.warmupExplanation: Computers use USB cables to talk to printers, game controllers, and Arduino boards.

steps.title: Board Architecture & Key Landmarks
steps.markdownContent: USB connects the board to a computer. Reset restarts the program. The L light is built in. Pin headers connect wires and parts.

steps.title: Drag & Match Board Landmarks
steps.markdownContent:
### Put Your Board Knowledge to the Test! 🎯

Inspect your physical Arduino Uno board, then match each label badge to its corresponding landmark below:
- **USB Connection**: Silver port that links to PC for flashing code & 5V power.
- **DC Power Barrel Jack**: Black round port for external 9V battery or wall adapter.
- **Digital Pins (0–13)**: Top header pins sending & receiving binary HIGH/LOW.
- **Analog Pins (A0–A5)**: Bottom right pins converting variable analog voltages into discrete 10-bit ADC readings (0–1023).

Drag each badge into its slot to complete the hardware inspection!
